يرتجعا (form VIII)

# يُرْتَجَعَا (yurtajaʕā) /jur.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
